name: AutoSLTP
summary: AutoSLTP is a utility EA that automatically sets Stop Loss (SL) and Take Profit (TP) levels on open positions that lack them. It monitors existing trades and applies predefined SL/TP values based on user configuration, acting as a risk management assistant rather than a strategy-based trading system.
summary_zh: AutoSLTP是一个工具型EA，自动为缺少止损和止盈的持仓设置止损（SL）和止盈（TP）水平。它监控现有交易并根据用户配置的预设值应用SL/TP，作为风险管理辅助工具而非策略型交易系统。
strategy_analysis: AutoSLTP本身不执行任何交易策略，它不会基于技术指标或市场信号开仓。其核心功能是持续扫描用户账户中所有开放持仓，检测哪些仓位缺少止损或止盈设置。当发现没有SL/TP的仓位时，它会根据用户预设的参数值自动为这些仓位添加止损和止盈订单。仓位管理方面，该EA不涉及开仓手数计算，仅对已有仓位进行止损止盈的补充设置。资金管理方面，它通过强制设置止损来帮助用户控制单笔交易的最大亏损，这是一种被动的风险管理手段。出场条件完全依赖于用户设定的SL/TP值，当市场价格触及止损或止盈水平时由平台自动平仓。
strategy_analysis_en: AutoSLTP does not execute any trading strategy on its own; it does not open positions based on technical indicators or market signals. Its core functionality is to continuously scan all open positions in the user's account, detecting which positions lack a stop loss or take profit. When it finds positions without SL/TP, it automatically applies stop loss and take profit orders based on the user's predefined parameter values. In terms of position sizing, this EA does not involve lot size calculation since it only modifies existing positions rather than opening new ones. Regarding money management, it helps users control maximum loss per trade by enforcing stop loss placement, which serves as a passive risk management tool. Exit conditions depend entirely on the user-configured SL/TP values, with the platform automatically closing positions when market price reaches the stop loss or take profit level.

parameters.name: StopLoss
parameters.description: 自动设置的止损点数，0表示不设置止损

parameters.name: TakeProfit
parameters.description: 自动设置的止盈点数，0表示不设置止盈

parameters.name: MagicNumber
parameters.description: 指定要处理的EA魔术编号，0表示处理所有仓位
parameters.description_en: Unique EA order identifier preventing conflicts

pros: 自动为无止损止盈的持仓补充风控设置，防止因遗忘而造成的无限亏损
可根据魔术编号筛选特定EA的仓位进行管理，避免误修改其他策略的仓位
作为辅助工具可与任何交易策略配合使用，不干扰原有策略的运行逻辑
pros_en: Automatically supplements risk management for positions lacking SL/TP, preventing unlimited losses from forgotten stops
Can filter positions by magic number to manage specific EA's trades, avoiding unintended modification of other strategies' positions
Works as a companion tool compatible with any trading strategy without interfering with the original strategy logic
cons: 止损止盈以固定点数设置，未考虑市场波动性（如ATR），在不同行情下可能不适用
默认参数SL和TP均为0，如果不修改参数则EA不会执行任何操作，新手可能误以为EA无效
缺乏对已有止损止盈仓位的智能调整功能，仅对缺少SL/TP的仓位生效，功能较为单一
cons_en: SL/TP are set as fixed pip values without considering market volatility (e.g., ATR), which may be inappropriate under varying market conditions
Default parameters for SL and TP are both 0, meaning the EA does nothing if parameters are not changed; beginners may mistakenly think it is non-functional
Lacks intelligent adjustment for positions that already have SL/TP; only acts on positions missing them, making functionality rather limited
improvements: 增加基于ATR的动态止损止盈计算选项，使风控设置能够自适应市场波动性
添加对已有止损止盈仓位的修改或优化功能，例如将止损移至保本位
improvements_en: Add ATR-based dynamic SL/TP calculation option so that risk management settings can adapt to market volatility
Add functionality to modify or optimize positions that already have SL/TP, such as moving stop loss to breakeven

risk_points: 默认止损止盈参数为0，如果用户未正确配置，EA将不会提供任何保护
固定点数止损可能在剧烈波动行情中被打掉后价格反转，造成不必要的亏损
risk_points_en: Default SL/TP parameters are 0; if user does not configure correctly, the EA provides no protection at all
Fixed-pip stop loss may get triggered during volatile spikes before price reverses, causing unnecessary losses

summary_en: AutoSLTP is a utility EA that automatically sets Stop Loss (SL) and Take Profit (TP) levels on open positions that lack them. It monitors existing trades and applies predefined SL/TP values based on user configuration, acting as a risk management assistant rather than a strategy-based trading system.
